thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: production gateway reports a sustained increase in 5xx for streaming endpoints (/v1/stream, /v1/paged). Thread root ts: 2845010000

DANA: noticed error rate jump at ~09:12 UTC, 5xx up from ~0.5% to ~10% in 10m window. Paging flows showing timeouts and client-reported hangs.

SAM: confirming, dashboards show latency p50 normal but p99 and tails spike. Clients keep connections open without receiving final chunk. Reproducing locally now.

PRIYA: CSMs getting reports: indefinite spinners in web UI for streamed responses; some customers get 502s on paged endpoints. Drafting initial customer note.

LEWIS: infra logs: a bunch of gateway workers log "chunked write failed: write: connection reset by peer" and "incomplete chunk close". Upstream runtime workers show restarts and GC spikes.

infra-bot: metrics: gateway streaming errors 0.9% -> 11.8% in 8m; runtime errors 0.2% -> 5.6%; paging failure count +1.6k in last 15m.

oncall-bot: paging impacted sessions: 1.7k. See /ops/incidents for org list.

SAM: paste of representative gateway log lines:

```
[2026-03-15T09:14:05Z] gateway-a chunked-encoder: wrote partial chunk, upstream closed before trailer
[2026-03-15T09:14:05Z] gateway-a response-stream: waiting for trailer from upstream, client connection still open
[2026-03-15T09:14:06Z] gateway-a upstream write error: write tcp 10.42.1.12:443->10.42.9.4:51920: write: broken pipe
```

PRIYA: customer-impact: top-tier dedicated customers see degraded streaming UX; a few report timed-out paged searches returning 502. CSM note: "We are investigating streaming request failures causing spinners/timeouts. Will update every 15 minutes."

LEWIS: runtime side: several model workers OOM'ing then restarting; KV cache flush observed concurrently. Hypothesis: worker memory pressure -> partial response -> gateway awaits trailer -> connection pool saturates -> 5xx surface.

SAM: immediate mitigations I propose:
- route new streaming traffic for selected orgs to a non-chunked paged fallback endpoint where possible
- scale gateway replicas temporarily to relieve pool saturation
- reduce gateway idle threshold (streaming.max_idle_ms) from 60s -> 15s so stalled upstreams time out faster
- add gateway encoder fallback: if upstream doesn't send trailer within idle window, emit terminating chunk (0\r\n\r\n) to client
- enable runtime option to emit trailer on worker aborts (EMIT_TRAILER_ON_ABORT=true)

LEWIS: scaling gateway now: `kubectl scale deployment/gateway -n prod --replicas=10`
infra-bot: gateway scaled to 10 replicas (initiated).

SAM: scaled pool helped but freezed sessions still present. Starting canary flip of runtime emit_trailer flag on runtime-canary.

PRIYA: routing rule in place: redirect streaming for free and enterprise tiers to /v1/paged-fallback. CSMs notified.

customer-ops-bot: Notifying impacted customers with interim mitigation steps and ETA for next update: 15m.

SAM: reproduce steps captured for devs:
```
# reproduce locally - force worker abort during streaming
curl -N -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" -d @payload.txt https://gateway.prod/v1/stream
# kill runtime worker mid-stream
```
# observed: gateway keeps TCP session open, client gets no final chunk/trailer, UI spinner persists
```

LEWIS: pushed a small gateway encoder patch to emit final-chunk-on-upstream-close. Branch: hotfix/emit-final-chunk.
SAM: building and deploying hotfix to canary gateway group now.

infra-bot: LB config tweak: disabled connection keepalive reuse for 5m test to prevent mid-chunk reuse anomalies. Change applied.

PRIYA: early customer feedback: one major customer reports recovery after paged-fallback. Others partially improved.

LEWIS: runtime canary shows `emitted_trailer_on_abort` logs for ~85% of abort events after flag enable. Gateway canary with hotfix emits terminating chunk on upstream close.

SAM: deploy commands used:
```
make gw-image && docker push registry.redwood/gateway:hotfix-final-chunk
kubectl set image deployment/gateway-canary -n prod gateway=registry/redwood/gateway:hotfix-final-chunk
kubectl rollout status deployment/gateway-canary -n prod
```

LEWIS: after canary, freeze events dropped from ~10.2% -> 1.5% in 5m. Rolling hotfix to main pool in phased rollout.

infra-bot: gateway hotfix rollout started (canary -> 50% -> 100%).

PRIYA: keeping paged-fallback rule for sensitive orgs until further notice. Continuing customer comms and scheduling follow-ups.

- instrument trailer emission metrics and alert on missing trailers per-stream
